routing changes only after a passing trial, via an owner-accepted spec change
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the pre-1.0 panel review addendum (Beamfall fit and corvint-tasks), scratchpad review/out/panel-addendum.md. §5 disputed item 1 and §6 item 1. context --task scored recall 4/4 (LCRES-15) and 4/6 (COREAPI-AUDIT-0822-3) on Beamfall; the routed query verb scored 0-1 and returned a confident wrong READY. context is experimental (task-context-packet-v0.md) and cannot be promoted before its paired trial against grep. Build a frozen orientation set from Beamfall history, run the trial, and only if it passes route the skills (integrations/claude-code/plugins/corvint/skills/context/SKILL.md) and DOGFOOD §1 to context.
title: orientation: run the context --task paired-trial gate on Beamfall roadmap-ticket-to-diff tasks, then route orientation to it
